nodes.label: Independent Pipeline Stages
nodes.rationale: Generation, queueing, and publishing are deliberately separated so publishing transmits queued posts verbatim without referral or quality-gate mutation.

nodes.label: Semantic Deduplication
nodes.rationale: An Arabic-normalized, IDF-weighted semantic index rejects literal duplicates, paraphrases, and repeated ideas against all generated, queued, previewed, and previously published content.

nodes.label: Strict Content Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: Automatically rejects malformed, incomplete, incorrectly sized, or language-contaminated AI output before it reaches the shared queue.

nodes.label: Generation-Time Referral Link Injection
nodes.rationale: Referral links are inserted while content is generated so the publishing engine can remain referral-agnostic and post text unchanged.

nodes.label: Unbounded Parallel Generation Sessions
nodes.rationale: The selected session count runs concurrently and can change during generation, with staggered launch preserving UI responsiveness at high concurrency.

nodes.label: Consumptive Shared Queue
nodes.rationale: Successful posts are immediately and permanently removed, while unpublished items remain in place for the next account or run, enforcing one-time publication.

nodes.label: Ordered Numbered Profiles
nodes.rationale: Profiles receive mandatory sequence numbers and publishing proceeds only forward from the selected profile, preventing backward wraparound.

nodes.label: Rate-Limit Failover
nodes.rationale: A post that encounters an X daily limit is handed to the next account while the original account advances and enters a persisted cooldown.

nodes.label: Publishing Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: An account is stopped defensively after three consecutive unexplained failures.

nodes.label: Immediate Stop
nodes.rationale: The stop action interrupts waits and retries within 200 milliseconds rather than waiting for an operation cycle to finish.

nodes.label: Anti-Detection Automation
nodes.rationale: Random delays, natural pointer movement, human-like scrolling, and retries make automated posting behavior less mechanically uniform.

nodes.label: Virtual Lists
nodes.rationale: Virtualized rendering keeps queue and preview interactions smooth with thousands of posts.

nodes.label: Live Run Reporting
nodes.rationale: Percentage, fractional progress, and per-session CSV logs expose ongoing publishing state.

nodes.label: Automated Security Audit
nodes.rationale: The audit checks hard-coded links and state-file integrity.

nodes.label: Local-Only API Key Storage
nodes.rationale: API keys remain on the user's machine and are excluded from logs to limit credential exposure.

nodes.label: AI Provider Auto-Detection
nodes.rationale: The provider type is inferred from the Base URL so one settings flow can support multiple compatible AI services.
